headline: Charleston and Concord meet level at the top
dek: Charleston beat Salem and Concord won at West Virginia Wesleyan, leaving the two level on thirty points with a conference defeat apiece. Davis & Elkins, idle since their goalless draw with West Liberty, sit four points back. Charleston won the first meeting between the leaders, in September.
displaced_by: Charleston and Concord both won to stand level on thirty points with Davis & Elkins four back, so the standing dek's figures no longer hold; the leaders meet next

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and fifteen different players have shared their forty-eight; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston beat Concord, Concord beat Davis & Elkins, and Davis & Elkins beat Charleston: the top of the table is a circle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded seven goals in fifteen matches and won eleven of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after fourteen matches, with three draws and eleven defeats, and have conceded forty-seven goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has seven goals and five assists for Frostburg State from thirty-two shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Fauli has eight assists and four goals for Davis & Elkins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shai'ya Fitzgerald has made sixty-two saves for West Liberty and conceded fifteen goals.

last_match.line: Charleston have now beaten Salem home and away; Salem have yet to take a point from either leader.

next_match.line: Virginia State have yet to score against this conference, held by Frostburg State and beaten by Concord.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
